# digidelic Design System

> Saturated neon-on-void brand and UI system. Zero border radius, pure-black canvas, mono-first typography, solid-block color. Brutalist FUI vocabulary — mission-control interfaces, WILLB/Clov color blocking, ASCII glitch texture.

## Non-negotiable laws

- Background is pure black (`#000` / `#0a0a0a`). Never a gradient.
- Border radius is `0`. Universal, no exceptions.
- Color arrives in solid blocks. No soft fills, no glassmorphism, no blurred shadows.
- Text on any brand fill flips to black.
- Default border: 1px white @ 12% alpha. No other resting border treatment.
- Depth is a hard offset shadow (`3px 3px 0 0`), never a blur. Hover translates `-2px,-2px`; active snaps to `0,0`.
- No emoji, no exclamation points. Punctuation is structure: `// >> :: — ▶ ×`.
- ALL CAPS for structural text; lowercase for body and system output.
- Numeric readouts use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

## Entry points

- [styles.css](styles.css): single stylesheet import — pulls in tokens, base elements, motifs, glitch layer.
- [tokens.json](tokens.json): W3C DTCG tokens — colors (with contrast ratios), type, spacing, motion, elevation, focus, target sizes.
- [README.md](README.md): full human documentation.
- [tailwind.config.js](tailwind.config.js): Tailwind drop-in config.

## Foundations

- [Accessibility](preview/foundations-accessibility.html): computed contrast pairing table, muted-text floor, focus ring, target sizes, motion policy, keyboard contract.
- [Component States](preview/foundations-states.html): global rest / hover / focus / active / disabled / loading / error reference.
- [Anatomy](preview/foundations-anatomy.html): labeled subpart diagrams for button, card, input, nav item.

## Critical constraints for generated code

- `--blue #2d6cff` is **3.59:1 on black** — a FILL color only. Never body text. Put white text on the blue instead (5.85:1).
- Informational text never below `rgba(255,255,255,0.55)` (6.25:1). `--white-faint` (0.35) is decorative only.
- Focus ring: `2px solid #2d6cff` at `1px` offset. Add `.focus-invert` on cobalt-filled elements to flip the ring to white.
- Every looping animation must collapse under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
- Minimum target 24×24px; 44×44px on touch.

## UI kits

- [digidelic React app](ui_kits/digidelic/index.html): full node-grid mission-control prototype.
- [Tailwind build](ui_kits/digidelic-tailwind/index.html): CDN showcase + usage docs.
- [shadcn/ui theme](ui_kits/shadcn/index.html): variable theme in `ui_kits/shadcn/globals.css`.
- [daisyUI theme](ui_kits/daisyui/index.html): drop-in `daisyui-digidelic.css`.

## Optional

- Component cards live at `preview/components-*.html` — buttons, inputs, cards, badges, navigation, overlays, data display, disclosure, menus, log rows.
- Brand cards at `preview/brand-*.html` — logo, motifs, textures, glitch, psychedelia, night garden, zine system, style references.
- Fonts in `fonts/` (Geist Mono, Red Hat Mono, variable TTF). Space Grotesk from Google Fonts.
